append.detail: ACCEPTED 2026-10-06 by owner ruling (ADR-1707): the leftover Space tabs, the per-Space podcasts index and the /events index stay dynamic for crawlers at about 150 URLs; the ISR split is not built. Revisit when networked Spaces pass 100 or crawler load is measurable. The original probe, kept for whoever reopens this: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const lay="app/(main)/layout.tsx",rw="lib/nav/member-space-rewrite.ts",sm="app/sitemap.ts";for(const f of [lay,rw,sm]){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-788: "+f+" missing");process.exit(79)}}const bad=[];const smap=fs.readFileSync(sm,"utf8");const adv=(re)=>re.test(smap);if(adv(/\$\{SITE_URL\}\/events`/)&&!fs.existsSync("app/(public)/events/page.tsx"))bad.push("the /events index is in the sitemap but has no ISR public page");if(adv(/\/spaces\/\$\{s\.slug\}\/podcasts`/)&&!fs.existsSync("app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/podcasts/page.tsx"))bad.push("the per-Space podcasts index is in the sitemap but has no ISR public page");if(adv(/listNetworkedSpaceProfileTabs\(/)&&!fs.existsSync("app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/book/page.tsx"))bad.push("the profile tabs are in the sitemap but none has an ISR public page");const r=fs.readFileSync(rw,"utf8");if(!/\/spaces\\\/\(\[\^\/\]\+\)\\\/\(/.test(r)&&!/book/.test(r))bad.push("memberSpaceRewrite still rewrites only the Space home and the Show page, so a signed-in member of a private Space would 404 on a moved tab");const l=fs.readFileSync(lay,"utf8");const a=l.indexOf("await getCachedUser()"),b=l.indexOf("if (isPublicView) return publicChrome()");if(a>-1&&b>-1&&a<b)bad.push("the (main) layout still reads the auth cookie before returning publicChrome for a leftover public view");if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-788: crawlers fetch sitemap-advertised Space tabs, the podcasts index and the events index as fully dynamic renders with an auth read: "+bad.join("; ")+".");process.exit(1)}'
